thread:
emma: Heads-up — v1.14 release branch cutoff in ~12h. Can docs/console + SDK teams confirm regen and staging deploy? Need changelog entry for v1.14 by EOD.

raj: On it. I'll draft the changelog PR and add the release notes section. Ping me if you want a specific phrasing. :memo:

casey: SDK regen started locally. Plan: regen -> run integration tests -> upload artifacts. ETA ~3h. Any API breaking changes?

emma: Only one small param rename in the public deployments API: `region` -> `preferred_region`. Not blocking but please include migration note in SDK changelog.

casey: Got it. Will include a snippet and bump SDK version to 0.9.2 in the regen commit.

olivia: Staging docs deploy window is 02:00 UTC. Can we freeze docs merges at 01:30 UTC so deploy build is deterministic?

raj: Freezing at 01:30 UTC works for me. I'll aim to have the changelog PR up and merged before then.

casey: I can schedule the SDK docs regen job for 00:45 UTC and upload the static site artifacts to the staging bucket. That gives time for the site build before 02:00.

emma: Perfect. Also please add a short migration code snippet in the console upgrade guide — something like:
```
- // old
- deploy({ region: 'us-west-2' })
+ // new
+ deploy({ preferred_region: 'us-west-2' })
```

raj: Adding that now. I'll also append a one-liner to the top of the changelog: "Param rename: region -> preferred_region (no behavior change)."

dev-bot: Quick check — CI:docs pipeline currently green, no blocker labels on docs PRs. :white_check_mark:

casey: One more ask: if anyone is touching example notebooks, tag me in the PR so I can run the regen locally before merge.

emma: Will do. Last note — if changelog misses anything, we'll hold non-critical console changes to next release. Stick to the freeze unless urgent. :lock:

raj: PR opened: #3456 — requesting @casey for SDK snippet, @olivia for deploy window ack.

casey: Reviewing. Will push SDK regen artifact after tests pass (~45m). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia: Acked for freeze and deploy window.

emma: Thanks team — keeping an eye on merges. Ping this thread if anything blocks. :rocket:
